title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Mappi to your own tools with API keys and webhooks.
notCopied: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Use a key in the X-API-Key header to read your questionnaires and answers from the external API.
keys.notInPlan: Your plan doesn't include the external API.
keys.emptyBody: Create a key to read your questionnaires and answers from your own systems.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeBody: Anything that uses "{{name}}" will stop working at once. This can't be undone.

reveal.title: Your new API key
reveal.warning: Copy this key now and keep it somewhere safe. You won't be able to see it again.
reveal.label: API key

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: We send a signed POST to your URL every time someone completes a questionnaire.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add an https URL to receive every completed response as soon as it arrives.
webhooks.deleteBody: We'll stop sending completed responses to {{url}}. Its delivery log is deleted too.

form.urlHttps: The URL must start with https://
form.urlInvalid: Enter a valid URL, like https://example.com/hook

log.title: Deliveries
log.intro: The last 20 deliveries to {{url}}. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 6 h.
log.emptyBody: They appear here once someone completes a questionnaire.

reference.title: Delivery reference
reference.intro: Each delivery is a POST with a JSON body and these headers. Answer with any 2xx status within 5 seconds; anything else is retried.
reference.signature: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, in hex, with your account's signing secret.
reference.deliveryId: The same on every retry of one delivery: use it to ignore duplicates.
reference.values: Values: text as a string, scales as a number with min and max, multiple choice and ranking as a list, files as storage keys, audio as transcriptions.

reference.title: External API
reference.intro: Read your account's data from your own systems. Every request needs an API key in the X-API-Key header and counts towards your plan's API usage.
reference.authBody: Send the key in the X-API-Key header. A missing, revoked or expired key gets 401 INVALID_API_KEY.
reference.listBody: Your questionnaires, newest first: id, flow_id, slug, title, description, is_active, type, created_at and updated_at.
reference.answersTitle: List the answers of a questionnaire
reference.answersBody: Each session with its answers ({title, value, min?, max?}), newest first. Another account's questionnaire gets 404.
reference.pagination: Pagination: page (from 1) and page_size (default 50, at most 50). The response has pagination {page, page_size, total_items, total_pages, has_next, has_previous}.
reference.errors: Errors: 401 INVALID_API_KEY, 404 QUESTIONNAIRE_NOT_FOUND, 429 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED when the plan's API quota is used up.
